title: Python Developer – Real-Time Stock News Scanner, Catalyst Analysis & AI Alerts

facts: Post: real-time US stock news scanner for discretionary day trading; decision support only, never trades.

Post: three watch types (small-cap short, small-cap long, large-cap long), NO FRESH CATALYST rule, alert format, sources Alpaca, Benzinga, SEC EDGAR, GlobeNewswire, Business Wire, PR Newswire, IR pages.
Personalization: Kambiz named in 4 separate client reviews; contact only.

cover.title: Know why a stock is moving
cover.caption: I've already put this workflow together for you. Let me walk you through how it works.

previewSteps.title: Read the news
previewSteps.detail: Wire services, Alpaca, Benzinga and SEC filings, checked for freshness.

previewSteps.title: Grade the catalyst
previewSteps.detail: Strong, puffy or no fresh catalyst, with the reasons.

previewSteps.title: Alert you
previewSteps.detail: One alert per real change, and you make the trade call.

cover.footer: Illustrative sample · invented tickers, news and timestamps
cover.beat: You want to know which movers have real news behind them, fast, without the system ever placing a trade. Here's one premarket run.

scenes.title: One premarket run at 6:12 AM
scenes.caption: News and filings come in, stale and duplicate stories drop out, and each mover gets a grade.
scenes.beat: At 6:12 Pacific, three movers have news. The Benzinga copy of the same press release is grouped with the original, the nine-day-old article on XTNA is thrown out, and PR Newswire timing out doesn't stop the run.
details: Python rules handle prices, timestamps, freshness and market hours. The AI only reads the release or filing and grades it.
The AI provider is a setting, so OpenAI, Anthropic or Google can be compared on the same test cases.
Breaking news is graded when it arrives, without waiting for the next 15-minute scan.

content.schedule: 5:00 AM to 4:00 PM PT · scans every 15 min · news handled on arrival
content.objective: Find stocks moving on fresh news, grade the catalyst, and alert you fast. No trades are placed.
content.summary: {{short.ticker}} is a short watch on thin news. {{long.ticker}} is a long watch on a signed contract. {{large.ticker}} has no fresh catalyst.

stories.title: {{short.ticker}} jumps {{short.move}} on a partnership with no disclosed value
stories.summary: Fresh release, {{short.age}} old. No dollar value, no revenue impact, and the agreement is not shown to be binding.
stories.why: The move is large for news this thin, and an S-3 shelf filed six weeks ago adds dilution risk.
stories.action: Short watch. Wait for your technical setup.
stories.confidence: Fresh and original source: verified. Substance: weak.
stories.uncertainty: The AI grades the wording. It does not know how the market will treat the news, so the chart decision stays with you.

evidence.title: GlobeNewswire release, 6:09 AM PT
evidence.excerpt: The companies plan to explore AI tools together. No financial terms were disclosed.

evidence.title: Benzinga copy of the same release, 6:10 AM PT
evidence.excerpt: Same text as E1. Grouped with it, so it counts as one story and one alert.

stories.title: {{long.ticker}} rises {{long.move}} after a signed supply contract
stories.summary: A signed multi-year contract with a stated value, confirmed by an 8-K filed the same morning.
stories.why: The contract value is disclosed and large next to the company's size, and the SEC filing backs the release.
stories.action: Long watch. Wait for your technical setup.
stories.confidence: Fresh, binding and value disclosed: verified.
stories.uncertainty: Revenue timing across the contract years is not stated. Check the filing before sizing a trade.

evidence.title: Form 8-K, SEC EDGAR, 6:15 AM PT
evidence.excerpt: Item 1.01, entry into a material definitive agreement: a signed three-year supply contract.

evidence.title: Business Wire release, 6:14 AM PT
evidence.excerpt: The company announces a signed supply contract and states its total value.

stories.title: {{large.ticker}} is up {{large.move}} with no fresh catalyst found
stories.summary: Big move, but the only article in the ticker search is nine days old and about a different product.
stories.why: Large caps are not flagged just for moving. Without verified fresh news, it is reported as no fresh catalyst.
stories.action: No watch. Recheck if new news or a filing appears.
stories.uncertainty: News may still be coming. A new release or filing would trigger a fresh grade and a new alert.

evidence.title: Ticker search result dated October 12
evidence.excerpt: Older article that mentions the ticker. Rejected as stale, so it is not attached to today's move.

health.failure: Timed out at 6:05 AM PT. The other feeds kept running.
health.retry: Retried with backoff at 6:06 and 6:08 AM PT. Heartbeat alert if it fails again.

history.status: Saved with sources, grades and the feed outage.

statuses: Five items read from news feeds and SEC filings

scenes.title: The alerts you'd get
scenes.caption: Each alert says what the news is, what's missing and which watch it fits.
scenes.beat: This is the alert format from your post. XQLM is a short watch because the partnership has no value attached and there's recent dilution. XBRV is a long watch on a signed contract. XTNA is reported as no fresh catalyst, and XQLM staying on the scanner doesn't send the same alert again.
details: Every alert ends with wait for your technical setup. Nothing is traded.
A repeat alert needs new news, a new filing, a big new move or a changed grade.

metrics.name: Time from news to alert
metrics.aim: Alert sooner after the original release
metrics.definition: Minutes from the original source timestamp to the alert, for each alert.

metrics.name: Wrong news attached
metrics.aim: Attach fewer old or unrelated articles
metrics.definition: Alerts where the attached news was stale, recycled or about another company, divided by all alerts, checked in your review.

metrics.name: Alerts worth a chart check
metrics.aim: Send more alerts you'd open the chart for
metrics.definition: Share of alerts you mark worth reviewing, across your historical cases and the live window.
